sn23.9:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn23.9:1.3: rūpe kho rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn23.9:1.4: evantaṃ rūpaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
sn23.9:1.5: vedanāya yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn23.9:1.6: evaṃ sā vedanā pahīnā bhavissati ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn23.9:1.8: saṅkhāresu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn23.9:1.9: evante saṅkhārā pahīnā bhavissanti ucchinnamūlā tālā vatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn23.9:1.10: viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha
sn23.9:1.11: evantaṃ viññāṇaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammanti.
